trap.label: formalidade
trap.wrong: Dear Mr. Silva, I am writing for ask about the job.
trap.right: Dear Mr. Silva, I am writing to ask about the job.
trap.why: Português: “escrevo para pedir” é igual, mas o brasileiro usa for. Em inglês: I am writing to + base.

fix.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
fix.right: I look forward to hearing from you.

fix.wrong: I am writing to ask for informations.
fix.right: I am writing to ask for information.

rewrite.prompt: Use I am writing: “I want to apply.”
Complete: “I look forward to … (hear) from you.”
rewrite.answer: I look forward to hearing from you.
